## Triage: first grade · `enhancement` · `priority:p1` · `target:v18` · `domain:ui` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-15T11:59Z

Read fresh. This is the objectui companion that the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/objectstack#23546 (`6190477105`, Q1 **A1**, `/diff` included) asks for.
- Setup's catalog editors show History and Audit to a walled organization admin (`ResourceEditPage.tsx`, `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, with no capability gate).
- Those doors are narrowing to `system`, `studio.access` and `manage_metadata`.

**Grade p1 + `target:v18`:** it is the consumer follow-up of a protocol-class narrowing, and without it users meet buttons that always answer 403 (A2's consequence, which the ruling chose A1 to avoid).

**Lane `domain:ui`** (`packages/app-shell`, metadata-admin).

**Not blocked, despite the body's `Blocked-by:` line:**
- Hiding the buttons from callers the narrowed doors refuse only removes what the ruling removes, so the two PRs may land in either order.
- The claimant links the objectstack PR (`domain:cli` seat 2, under claim `6188504102`) and aims to land in the same window, as the ruling asks.

**Scope:**
- History, Audit and the diff entry are shown only to a caller holding `system`, `studio.access` or `manage_metadata`.
- **Pins:**
  - a `setup.access`-only caller sees neither button;
  - a `studio.access` author sees both;
  - CONTROL: create mode is unchanged.

Claim: PM loop round 1
Session: `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`
Account: `baozhoutao` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12475-trail-doors-gate`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12475`

Seat: `domain:ui#2`
File surface: `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx` (the History and Audit entries only), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` (its History button only), any diff entry that reads `/meta/:type/:name/diff` from these editors, the existing capability-reading idiom's module only to reuse it (⛔ no new gate idiom), the tests beside each, and one `.changeset/12475-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` reads no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: no
Responsibility: `n/a — not a defect card`
Thread-read: 6191531169
Serial constraints cleared: no in-flight claim or open PR touches `ResourceEditPage.tsx` or `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`. objectui#12440 (PR #12473, `ListView.tsx` / `ObjectView.tsx`), objectui#12464 (PR #12485, `types` / `page.tsx` / the console sample) and objectui#12478 (claimed alongside, one app-shell test) are disjoint. The pin bump the body mentions is not this card's: triage scoped it to the buttons, and they may land in either order with objectstack-ai/objectstack#23546.

## Review: ACCEPT — objectui PR #12495 · `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB` · 2026-10-15T13:47Z

Reviewed on GitHub at head `b5b00b7`, against triage's scope (`6191531169`) and the claim (`6191990090`), not against the dev's report.

- **Shape:** the PR is a draft against `main`. Its body opens `Fixes #12475`, the only closing keyword, followed by `Clause-②: no`, and it names objectstack-ai/objectstack#23546 as the server half. The governed sweep reads NOT governed, 8 files.
- **One predicate, the existing idiom:**
  - `useCanReadAuthoringTrail()` sits beside `useCanAuthorMetadata` in `hooks/useCanAuthorMetadata.ts`. It answers ANY of `studio.access` and `manage_metadata` through the same `usePermissions().hasCapabilities` idiom, asking each capability on its own because `hasCapabilities` answers "holds all".
  - Unknown fails open, as `useCanAuthorMetadata` does, and the server enforces regardless.
  - `system` is a principal flag that `/auth/me/permissions` does not report, so it has no client half.
  - The module is not re-exported from the package entry (`exports` is `.` and `./styles.css`, and `src/index.ts` names neither symbol), so `Clause-②: no` holds.
- **The gated entries:**
  - `ResourceEditPage`: the History and Audit buttons AND both sheets render only under `!createMode && canReadTrail`, so the CONTROL (create mode) is unchanged.
  - `PermissionMatrixEditor`: the History button (routed and embedded) and the embedded History sheet render only under `canReadTrail`.
  - No entry in these editors calls `/meta/:type/:name/diff`; `DraftReviewPanel` and `LayeredDiff` compare locally from the layered read.
- **Pins and ablation:** 7 pins. A `setup.access`-only caller sees neither entry, routed or embedded; a `studio.access` author and a `manage_metadata` author see both; create mode is unchanged. Making the predicate `return true` fails the 2 setup-only pins. Restore was proven by blob hash.
- **Test harness edits:** three existing tests mocked the hook module without spreading the original. Each now spreads `importOriginal()`, a 2-line edit with no assertion changed.
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`.
- **Evidence:** `metadata-admin/` plus `hooks/` give 6184 passed and 1 skipped under the lock. The closure build and the app-shell type-check exit 0, and so does the battery.
- **Acceptance note (not filed):** the routed `MetadataResourceHistoryPage` is unguarded. A setup-only caller who reaches it by URL sees `HistoryPanel`'s error state with the server's 403 message. No editor leads there any more.
- **Filed from the dev report (class a):** objectui#12496. A `?tab=<sheet>` deep link on a metadata item page never opens its sheet, because the URL-sync effect deletes `tab` before the first-mount reader runs.
- **Landing order:** triage ruled the two halves may land in either order with objectstack-ai/objectstack#23546.
- **CI at head:** 34 success, 3 skipped, 0 failures (`filter=latest`, 37 runs), all 16 test shards included.

Next: `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`.
